title: AI 试点有结果，怎样从试用走向业务价值？
topic: 把联合交付、员工采用和业务指标连成规模化方案

source.title: EY and Microsoft announce global initiative to help clients scale AI enterprisewide value creation and move beyond experimentation
source.section: EY and Microsoft announce global initiative to help clients scale AI enterprisewide value creation and move beyond experimentation
source.type: Microsoft 与 EY 官方企业合作与业务转型公告
source.context: Microsoft / EY 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: Building on the success of the EY-Microsoft alliance, the organizations are jointly investing more than $1 billion in a new initiative to accelerate enterprise AI transformation
Integrated team of EY practitioners and Microsoft “forward deployed engineers” will help clients deploy AI solutions in core business functions at scale

Clients will be empowered to become Frontier Firms that scale and generate value, through workforce upskilling, embedded change management and continuous optimization of agentic AI transformation. EY and Microsoft will deploy integrated teams of engineers and business consultants aligned by industry. Together, they will co-develop and provide secure, industry-specific AI solutions focused on clients’ highest value business opportunities. Through this approach, organizations can accelerate AI adoption and continuously optimize operations to drive sustained business value.

The initiative is underpinned by EY as Client Zero, using the organization’s own teams to validate ways of working with Microsoft technologies. EY initially deployed Copilot to 150,000 Copilot users, recording a 15% boost in productivity that was reinvested into client delivery and learning. EY is also scaling Copilot through Microsoft 365 E7: The Frontier Suite, to its more than 400,000 people around the world, embedding agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise to drive business impact.

Modernizing finance operations with Microsoft Power Platform, integrating intelligent agents via Copilot Studio, which resulted in 95% faster lead times and a more than 37% reduction in operational costs.

Early adoption of Microsoft Azure AI Document Intelligence on its Global Tax Platform, applying advanced machine learning to automatically and accurately extract essential data from documents, which reduced manual workload by up to 90%.
translations: 在 EY 与微软长期合作取得成果的基础上，双方将联合投入超过 10 亿美元，启动一项新计划，加快企业 AI 转型。
EY 从业者与微软“前线部署工程师”组成的联合团队，将帮助客户在核心业务职能中大规模部署 AI 解决方案。
客户可以通过员工技能提升、把变革管理嵌入实施过程，以及持续优化智能代理 AI 转型，成为能够规模化创造价值的企业。EY 和微软将按行业部署由工程师和业务顾问组成的联合团队，共同开发安全、符合行业特点的 AI 方案，聚焦客户价值最高的业务机会。通过这种方式，企业可以加快 AI 采用并持续优化运营，推动长期业务价值。
EY 将自己作为“首个客户”，用自身团队验证与微软技术合作的工作方式。EY 最初向 15 万名 Copilot 用户部署该工具，生产力提高了 15%；EY 将这部分提升重新投入客户交付和员工学习。EY 目前也正通过 Microsoft 365 E7：The Frontier Suite 向全球 40 多万人推广 Copilot，在企业内部嵌入智能体 AI 能力，以推动业务成效。
EY 通过 Microsoft Power Platform 现代化财务运营，并经 Copilot Studio 集成智能代理后，交付周期缩短了 95%，运营成本降低了 37% 以上。
EY 在其全球税务平台中早期采用 Microsoft Azure AI Document Intelligence，利用机器学习自动、准确地提取文件中的关键信息，使人工工作量最多减少 90%。
fullTextParagraphs: Building on the success of the EY-Microsoft alliance, the organizations are jointly investing more than $1 billion in a new initiative to accelerate enterprise AI transformation
Integrated team of EY practitioners and Microsoft “forward deployed engineers” will help clients deploy AI solutions in core business functions at scale
As Client Zero, EY was one of the first organizations to adopt Microsoft 365 E7: The Frontier Suite, and is now scaling Copilot across its more than 400,000 people

LONDON — May 21, 2026 — The EY organization and Microsoft Corp. on Thursday announced a significant evolution of their alliance, investing more than $1 billion over five years and launching a new initiative to help organizations as they scale AI and deliver measurable, enterprisewide outcomes at scale. The initiative brings together Microsoft’s Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and EY industry professionals to accelerate AI adoption across change management delivery models, powered by Microsoft’s FDE AI-native Hypervelocity Engineering approach.

The initiative represents an important milestone in the long-standing EY-Microsoft alliance, demonstrating a shared commitment to client-centric AI-powered transformation across Tax, Assurance, Consulting and EY-Parthenon.

Clients will be empowered to become Frontier Firms that scale and generate value, through workforce upskilling, embedded change management and continuous optimization of agentic AI transformation. EY and Microsoft will deploy integrated teams of engineers and business consultants aligned by industry. Together, they will co-develop and provide secure, industry-specific AI solutions focused on clients’ highest value business opportunities. Through this approach, organizations can accelerate AI adoption and continuously optimize operations to drive sustained business value.

Janet Truncale, EY Global Chair and CEO, says, “Together with Microsoft, EY is supporting clients to unlock value through rapid deployment of AI at scale. With access to a single, integrated team, clients will have at their disposal both Microsoft’s market-leading engineering depth, alongside EY teams’ deep industry knowledge and change management capabilities. By combining people and innovation in this next phase of the Alliance, clients will be empowered to realize the transformative power of agentic AI within the enterprise.”

The initiative is underpinned by EY as Client Zero, using the organization’s own teams to validate ways of working with Microsoft technologies. EY initially deployed Copilot to 150,000 Copilot users, recording a 15% boost in productivity that was reinvested into client delivery and learning. EY is also scaling Copilot through Microsoft 365 E7: The Frontier Suite, to its more than 400,000 people around the world, embedding agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise to drive business impact.
Beyond Copilot, EY has implemented AI across its organization, including:

Modernizing finance operations with Microsoft Power Platform, integrating intelligent agents via Copilot Studio, which resulted in 95% faster lead times and a more than 37% reduction in operational costs.

Embedding a new multiagent framework — integrated with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Foundry and Microsoft Fabric — into EY Canvas, which encompassed the workflows of 130,000 Assurance professionals across 160,000 audit engagements.

Early adoption of Microsoft Azure AI Document Intelligence on its Global Tax Platform, applying advanced machine learning to automatically and accurately extract essential data from documents, which reduced manual workload by up to 90%.

Judson Althoff, CEO of Microsoft’s Commercial Business, says: “AI is quickly moving from experimentation to a core driver of business performance, and the companies pulling ahead are those scaling AI Transformation. Our initiative combines Microsoft’s trusted AI platform and engineering teams with EY’s industry capabilities and experience as Client Zero — applying these technologies across their own organization — to help customers move beyond pilots to enterprise execution, enhancing decision-making and delivering measurable impact.”

The offering will be fully integrated, with shared governance, aligned commercial models and accountability across both organizations. Initially, services and solutions will be focused across Finance, Tax, Risk, HR and Supply Chain within Financial Services, Industrials and Energy, Consumer and Retail, Government, and Health Care.
Learn more about the EY-Microsoft initiative here, and for more information on the EY-Microsoft Alliance, visit EY.com.
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
All in to shape the future with confidence.

EY refers to the global organization, and may refer to one or more, of the member firms of Ernst & Young Global Limited, each of which is a separate legal entity. Ernst & Young Global Limited, a UK company limited by guarantee, does not provide services to clients. Information about how EY collects and uses personal data and a description of the rights individuals have under data protection legislation are available via ey.com/privacy. EY member firms do not practice law where prohibited by local laws. For more information about our organization, please visit ey.com.
This news release has been issued by EYGM Limited, a member of the global EY organization that also does not provide any services to clients.

Microsoft (Nasdaq “MSFT” @microsoft) creates platforms and tools powered by AI to deliver innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers. The technology company is committed to making AI available broadly and doing so responsibly, with a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

scenario.title: EY 税务平台减少人工处理，怎样扩大 AI 应用？
english: EY’s Global Tax Platform uses Azure AI Document Intelligence to extract data from tax documents, reducing manual workload by up to 90%.
EY and Microsoft are forming integrated teams of engineers and business consultants to help clients scale AI in core functions.
Explain how to choose the next workflow, set baselines, and decide when adoption and business results justify a wider rollout.
chinese: EY 全球税务平台使用 Azure AI Document Intelligence 提取税务文件数据，将人工工作量最多减少了 90%。
EY 与 Microsoft 正组建由工程师和业务顾问组成的联合团队，帮助客户在核心职能中规模化应用 AI。
请说明如何选择下一条工作流程、设定基线，以及何时可以依据员工采用情况和业务结果扩大应用。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请用英语介绍 EY 全球税务平台的 AI 应用结果，并建议在扩大到其他流程前，如何选流程、设基线和判断是否继续。
firstAttempt.sample: EY’s Global Tax Platform uses Azure AI Document Intelligence to extract data from tax documents and has reduced manual workload by up to 90%. Before extending AI to finance or customer operations, we should select a high-volume workflow and form a team of business owners, engineers, and trainers. Set baselines for manual hours, cycle time, error rate, adoption, and cost. Scale only when data quality, employee adoption, and agreed business results meet the targets.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先报来源中的税务平台结果，再提出下一步推广前要验证的流程、基线和员工采用情况。

words.example: We will deploy the workflow at scale after the pilot.
words.translation: 试点之后，我们会规模化部署这套流程。
words.note: 表示从小范围试点扩大到更多团队或流程。

words.collocation: validate a workflow with frontline teams
words.example: We validated the workflow with frontline finance teams.
words.translation: 我们与一线财务团队共同验证了这套流程。
words.note: 检查流程在真实工作中是否可行、准确并能带来预期结果。

words.example: The new process reduced operational costs by 12%.
words.translation: 新流程使运营成本降低了 12%。
words.note: 业务运营过程中持续发生的成本。

structure.original: Through this approach, organizations can accelerate AI adoption and continuously optimize operations to drive sustained business value.
analysis: Through this approach 回指前面提到的联合团队和变革管理办法。
can accelerate 与 continuously optimize 并列，说明企业要采取的两项行动。
to drive sustained business value 说明这些行动要带来的业务结果。
structure.transfer: We can use a shared intake process to resolve cases faster and reduce repeat contacts.

rewrite.bad: AI worked in one department, so let’s install it everywhere.
rewrite.good: EY’s Global Tax Platform uses Azure AI Document Intelligence to extract data from tax documents and has reduced manual workload by up to 90%. Before extending AI to finance or customer operations, we should select a high-volume workflow and form a team of business owners, engineers, and trainers. Set baselines for manual hours, cycle time, error rate, adoption, and cost. Scale only when data quality, employee adoption, and agreed business results meet the targets.
rewrite.translation: EY 全球税务平台使用 Azure AI Document Intelligence 提取税务文件数据，将人工工作量最多减少了 90%。在把 AI 扩展到财务或客户运营前，我们应先选择高频流程，并组建由业务负责人、工程师和培训人员组成的团队。要为人工工时、处理周期、错误率、员工采用情况和成本设定基线。只有数据质量、员工采用情况和约定的业务结果都达到目标后，才扩大范围。
rewrite.pattern: The pilot improved [workflow]. Before scaling, we should [select / validate]. We will set baselines for [measures] and expand when [adoption/result criteria] are met.

cloze.prompt: We need to ______ the workflow with frontline teams.

operational costs 指运营过程中发生的成本。

apply.prompt: 我们会先建立交付周期和人工工时的基线。

translationPractice.answer: The team will deploy the assistant at scale after validation.

choice.prompt: 一个部门的 AI 试点减少了文档处理时间，管理层要求立即全面推广。哪种回应最稳妥？
options: Install the tool in every department because one pilot succeeded.
Identify similar workflows, set baselines, validate with business owners and engineers, and expand in stages when adoption and outcomes meet targets.
Wait for perfect data before testing any other workflow.
choice.why: 第二条在扩大前验证流程相似性、基线、采用情况和结果，同时仍允许分阶段推进。

output.prompt: 你要向客户建议把一个文档处理 AI 试点扩大到财务和采购团队。请用英语说明先筛选流程、组成联合团队、测量哪些基线，并设定何时扩大范围。
output.sample: The document-processing pilot reduced manual work, so we should assess similar finance and procurement workflows first. A joint team of process owners, engineers, and trainers can validate the workflow, prepare employees, and check data quality and security. We should track lead time, manual hours, error rates, and adoption against a baseline, then expand to the next teams when the agreed targets are met.
check: 从试点结果出发但不直接推断适用于所有流程
提出业务、工程与培训人员共同实施并准备员工培训
说明基线和扩大部署的条件
